name: dashboard-showcase
description: Configurability section: a faded product screenshot ringed by floating tip cards and image orbs, with a closing line. Live: the `.ap-dashboard` section on every vertical page.

title_accent.description: Word inside the heading to paint with the brand gradient. Must appear in title.

background.description: Soft background image behind the section.

tips.description: Up to four floating cards, placed as in the design. Each: title; optional icon (URL), icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt, tone (violet, blue, green, yellow) and rows (each: title, sub, chip, chip_tone — em, in, lb, yl, vi, bl; or parts, an ordered list of {kind: code|title|num|sub|sub14|chip|avatar, text, tone, muted, image}, with layout person or oper for the avatar rows).

orbs.description: Up to eight circular cut-outs around the screenshot. Each: image; optional alt, tone (red, lb, yl, green, in) and zoom (percent, default 100).

lede.description: Paragraph under the title (some product pages carry one).

checks.description: Tick-marked lines under the stage. Plain strings.

ctas.description: Buttons under the checks. Each: label, url, and mark (true sets UrsaAI as the brand mark, as live does on some pages). The first is solid, the rest outlined.

lede_max.description: Width cap of the lede, in px (live: 650 on Higher Education).

lede_size_m.description: Lede size at 768px and below, in px (live: 16 on Police, 18 elsewhere).

outline_fixed.description: Outline button at a fixed 48px with 16px padding, semibold (live Higher Education).

cta_stack.description: Width (px) at and below which the buttons stack full width. 0 keeps them in a row (live: 640 on K-12).

cta_top_tablet.description: Space above the buttons at 768px and below, in px (live: 16 on Police, 24 elsewhere).
